Message.MsgText: Attribute attribute does not accept value 'value'.

Explanation.p: The specified value is not supported by that parameter. For instance the '$operation' attribute of this Connector accepts the following string values: 'create', 'modify', 'delete' (case insensitive). If something else is passed into the attribute this error will occur.

OperatorResponse.p: Provide valid values for the Connector's parameters. Consult the documentation for the supported ones.

Message.MsgText: The IdML book is opened in REFRESH mode and supports only CREATE operations.

Explanation.p: The IdML book this Connector is working with has been opened in Refresh mode, meaning only 'create' operations may be used for it.

OperatorResponse.p: Set the operation to 'create' from the '$operation' attribute or as a delta operation (i.e. the operation set to delta tagged entry will override the operation attribute of the Connector). Alternatively, change the book mode to Delta (from the Open IdML Function Component).

Message.MsgText: No class type specified in the configuration of the IdML Ci and Relationship Connector.

Explanation.p: In order to discover the schema of this Connector, the class type parameter must be provided. Otherwise the Component does not know which attributes to display.

OperatorResponse.p: Set the required Class Type parameter from IdML Ci and Relationship Connector's configuration panel.

Message.MsgText: IdML Ci and Relationship Connector will work with book: book name.
The parameter param name was initialized with the value: 'value'.
The name of the currently used book 'book name' has been overridden to 'new name'.
Use an IT registry for the needed meta-data: 'use it registry'.
The book 'book name' does not exist or is already closed.

Explanation.p: The specified parameter is needed by the IdML Ci and Relationship Connector and must be provided.

OperatorResponse.p: Provide a value for this parameter.
